roles.title: Software Development Intern
roles.details: Working inside a small product team on Welup’s web platform for tech training and consulting. I pick up features end to end, from the UI to the API it talks to, and ship them through code review.
highlights: Build and maintain pages and components for the learning platform
Work through tickets with code review and pull requests
Pair with senior engineers on backend and data work

roles.title: AI & Automations Engineering
roles.summary: Ongoing AI and automation engineering programme.
roles.details: A structured programme on applying AI and workflow automation to real business problems: connecting tools, moving data between systems, and putting language models to work where they actually save time.
highlights: Design automation workflows that connect forms, CRMs, email and databases
Use language models for intake, classification and drafting steps
Ship small working projects as part of the programme

roles.title: Front-End Developer
roles.summary: Client web apps in React/Next.js/TypeScript; UI performance work; Zustand/Redux state and Socket.io realtime.
roles.details: Building client web apps for a design and development agency. Designers hand over Figma files and I turn them into fast, responsive interfaces, wire up state and realtime features, and keep them quick as they grow.
highlights: Turn Figma designs into production React and Next.js interfaces
Manage app state with Zustand and Redux
Find and fix slow renders and heavy pages

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.summary: UI components for a health and care web app; API integration with the team.
roles.details: Worked with the Caretrax team on a web app for health and care providers. I built reusable interface components and connected them to the team’s APIs, so screens showed real data and handled loading and error states properly.
highlights: Built reusable UI components for care records and schedules
Integrated screens with the team’s REST APIs
Handled loading, empty and error states across the app

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.summary: Responsive business web app; SEO and page-load improvements.
roles.details: Built a responsive web app for the business, then made it easier to find and quicker to open: cleaner metadata and structure for search engines, lighter images and less JavaScript on first load.
highlights: Built the responsive web app from scratch
Improved SEO: metadata, page structure and sitemap
Cut page-load time with image and bundle work
